result.topic_en: Relations between hypergeometric P-functions with exponents (a, b, c) and with sign-changed exponents, using products of Pi (Gamma) functions rewritten as sines/cosines, and transformations involving x/(x-1) with exponential factors.

methods.what: Expressing one P-function as a multiple of the P-function with the sign of one exponent changed, coefficient a ratio of Gamma (Pi) function products
Rewriting the Gamma-ratio coefficient via the reflection formula as a product of sines, then cosines, times a constant K
Transformation of the P-function under x -> x/(x-1), interchanging exponents b and c with an exponential phase factor
